searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline) for AWA Radiola bakelite, HMV bakelite radio, Healing Golden Voice; work/comps.py bakelite radio (3 years, 38 local hits, median $62). Three WebSearch queries failed because the search budget was used up, so no web comps were found; no direct-source fetches made. Only Leski sales are non-local competitive results and they are for the 1940s bakelite Golden Voice, not this grey plastic 5-valve model. Plain mantel radios of this type sit around $20-80 each locally; the Golden Voice grey is likely the best of the three but still modest. eBay sold listings would settle resale.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia sold listings: 'Healing Golden Voice radio' (check the grey plastic model separately from bakelite), 'AWA Radiola bakelite mantel radio', 'HMV bakelite radio'.
viewing_check: Check the Healing model number on the back or chassis label and whether the case is intact; look at the extent of the crack on the brown HMV and whether the back panels and valves are present; see if cords are cut or perished.
